usedFor: Humantic AI builds personality profiles, using “Create Humantic Profile” and “Upload text to Humantic Profile” to feed them.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Salesforce, then “Upload text to Humantic Profile” in Humantic AI
bestTemplate.why: A new lead's text goes into a profile, so you can read how they communicate before outreach.

watchOut: “Upload text to Humantic Profile” in Humantic AI adds text to a profile, so check it is the right profile.
